text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Inductor ripple produces a triangular capacitor current and a curved voltage ripple

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Periodic ripple model with ideal capacitor,constant load current2 A,V_in12 V,D0.4,f_s50 kHz,L100 µH,C47 µF. Capacitor voltage is a time integral of i_C;
it is quadratic on each switching interval, not triangular when ESR is neglected. Mean ripple is removed explicitly. Finite ESR adds an instantaneous
ESR·i_C term; switching edges/parasitic spikes are omitted.
